title: V0CALYST announces "SuperBlue"
author: Jori
description: V0CALYST has officially announced SuperBlue. Serving as his second EP this year following 7 deadly sins and executively produced by SAKRAMENTO affiliate andiekyte, the project is locked in for release this Saturday.

title: V0CALYST on ZOMBIEBOY & Vocal Versatility
author: Jori
description: We sat down with V0CALYST to discuss the RAINOUT era, the influence of xaviersobased, and the upcoming deluxe album.

title: From 'YDL' to 'Yestuary': Inside suuni’s Evolution
author: Jori
description: We sat down with RAINOUT co-founder suuni to discuss his scrapped debut, balancing school with music, and his massive pipeline of influences.

title: Lunamaryllis on 'metaphysical ☆ decay', Vocals, her name
author: Jori
description: We sat down with lunamaryllis to discuss her shift from ambient DnB to vocal-heavy production, her upcoming projects, and the meaning behind her name.

title: sollaceee! on appleLove, the ruubie alias, and Meeting Earl
author: Jori
description: We sat down with sollaceee! to discuss the riotous energy of appleLove, dropping the KIDS CAN'T KILL! deluxe, and their future as a producer.

title: RAINOUT Timeline now in development
author: Jori
description: The RAINOUT Timeline is officially in development so newcomers can learn about the history of the collective.
